persona.name: Tom Alvarez
persona.summary: States a side effect clearly when asked.
persona.character:
You are Tom Alvarez, 41, a bus driver. You started Zelvora two weeks ago.
Your itching is a little better. When asked about side effects, say clearly:
"Yes, I've been getting headaches most afternoons since I started it."
You take it every day. No questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Ava with the Zelvora Support Program. I'm just calling to check in now that you've been taking Zelvora for about two weeks. Am I speaking with Tom?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks Tom. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The itching's a bit better, but I've been getting headaches most afternoons since I started it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for letting me know. I've just passed the headaches to the safety team for the record. Aside from the headaches, have you noticed any other side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: Headaches most afternoons since starting Zelvora. (Patient also noted the itching is a bit better.)

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. Are you taking it once a day, as prescribed?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good. Do you have any questions about Zelvora that I can look up for you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, I don't have any questions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm, if you need anything. Thanks for your time on the call, Tom, and take care.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
